requirements.command: bcs-cli visibility set --value protected + bcs-cli visibility set --value public
requirements.expectation: Product CLI changes customer-service visibility to protected and can restore it to public after the friendship decision, with no unrelated visibility mutation.

requirements.command: bcs-cli friend request --bot-uuid <CS> + friend requests --direction received --status pending + friend reject --request-id <ID> + friend list
requirements.expectation: Engineering creates one protected CS friendship request, customer-service selects and rejects the exact request, and engineering's final friend list omits CS while the rejected request remains identifiable.
PM creates exactly one CLI-managed release coordination Group and the later CLI read confirms its group ID and driver Bot without prompting or inventing an identifier.
PM adds QA to the exact CLI-created Group and the returned Group read contains QA, using only the owned Group and no borrowed fixture.
PM's CLI group listing contains the exact created Group and the CLI result count agrees with the formal bot-group API count, with no unrelated group counted.
PM invokes the exact owned Group fuse operation with two or more owned participants and receives a recommendation payload, not a synthetic or simulated fusion result.
PM marks the exact owned Group completed and a later CLI read reports completed; cleanup keeps the Group retained rather than silently deleting or pretending it was removed.
PM terminates exactly the second owned CLI-created Group, the later read reports completed, and cleanup is restricted to that Group rather than broad or shared resources.
